summary: Candidate is a distinct quantitative scale configuration skill (logarithmic) with unique mathematical properties (positive domain, base configuration, logarithmic tick computation) that differs semantically from peer candidates (quantile, threshold, ordinal scales) and existing skills (which are Flink data streaming, not D3 visualization). No existing skill covers logarithmic scale setup. Peer candidates are sibling scale types, not overlapping. Support evidence validates the D3 API methods.
